name: lookup_npg_location
description: Look up one NPG appointment office in the caller-safe current directory. Use this before stating an address, building, floor, suite, office, or arrival instruction. Only a response whose status is matched is approved for caller guidance.

request_body_schema.description: A bounded location query based only on the city, state, and address information supplied by the caller.

query.description: City, state, and street address from the caller or appointment paperwork. Do not include a person name, provider name, phone number, appointment identifier, or medical information.
